context.issue_text:
Cross-instance-same-tenant attachment-content denial is timing-distinguishable from cross-tenant/never-issued denial via an unconditional artifact-blob read.

Full detail in docs/issues/ISS-0785.yaml.

Summary: Letflow.Repository.Attachments.get_content/2 (lib/letflow/repository/attachments.ex ~362-445) performs an unconditional Repo.get on the artifact blob whenever the attachment metadata row exists, regardless of instance_id. The instance_id check in fetch_scoped_attachment_content/4 (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex ~1156) happens AFTER get_content/2 returns. This makes cross-instance-same-tenant denials cost 2 Repo round-trips (second reads the full artifact byte blob) vs 1 for cross-tenant/never-issued. This is a timing side-channel that distinguishes two classes of denial that REQ-211/212 explicitly intends to be indistinguishable.

Suggested fix (from ISS-0785.yaml): Reorder get_content/2's lookup so instance_id check happens before the artifact blob read, OR thread instance_id into get_content/2 so it can fold the cross-instance case into the same single-round-trip nil path.
